description: The Medium Resolution Spectral Imager (MERSI) on FY-3A is a 20-channel multispectral optical imaging radiometer covering the visible, near-infrared, shortwave-infrared, and thermal-infrared spectral regions. It measures cloud properties, aerosols, ocean color, vegetation index, and land surface characteristics.
short_description: FY-3A Medium Resolution Spectral Imager (MERSI), 20 channels
facility_description: FengYun-3A is China’s first second-generation polar-orbiting meteorological satellite, launched in May 2008 and operated by the National Satellite Meteorological Center (NSMC) of the China Meteorological Administration (CMA).
